CA.name: American cow-parsnip
CA.citation: Wikipedia; Go Botany. Preferred over bare 'cow parsnip', which per Wikipedia is more internationally associated with the European Heracleum sphondylium; emphatically distinct from the dangerous invasive Heracleum mantegazzianum (giant hogweed)
